text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Arima Kinen, and
everyone is
talking about how this is the
last race for the
exceptionally talented
Oguri Cap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан boldly proclaims that she
won't let
Oguri Cap be the star of this
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп, Мэдзиро МакКуин, and Mejiro
Ryan are
here...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And all three of them are putting their
dreams on
the line as the Arima Kinen
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
